fields.Fees — Published:
Official 2026–27 MBA: ₹1,79,100 year 1 + ₹1,69,200 year 2 = ₹3,48,300 gross, including ₹5,000 refundable security. Net academic charges ₹3,43,300; university pre-registration extra.

fields.Fee Scope: Two-year academic total excludes ₹5,000 refundable security and university pre-registration. Optional bus/hostel extra; tuition may be revised by UP fee committee.
fields.Eligibility: Recognised three-year bachelor’s degree. Official eligibility page states MBA 45% General/40% SC/ST; direct-admission page leaves marks to college policy. Confirm the applicable current UPTAC rule before applying.
fields.Selection Process: University counselling and 15% management quota under UP/AKTU rules. Direct admission requires application, document verification and college criteria.
